title: stablesign errSecInternalComponent means locked keychain: pause and ask the operator to unlock
content: When `stablesign` (b1-stablesign.sh) fails with errSecInternalComponent while re-signing a redeployed binary (blackboxd, bro-harness), the cause is a locked login keychain, not a sandbox or session problem. Do not retry with sandbox tricks, launchctl asuser, or osascript, and do not leave the ad-hoc-signed binary deployed as the outcome. Pause, tell the operator the keychain is locked, ask them to unlock it, then re-run `stablesign <path>` and verify `codesign -dvv` shows Authority=PlanGlobal Stable Codesign before reporting the redeploy done.
